definitions.gloss: the top leadership; the senior management team
definitions.explanation: The group of people at the very top of an organization, taken as a body: a company's executives, a party's leaders, or a team's coaching staff. Used when the whole leadership acts together.

examples.japanese: {首脳陣|しゅのうじん}が{交代|こうたい}した。
{会社|かいしゃ}の{首脳陣|しゅのうじん}が{緊急|きんきゅう}の{会議|かいぎ}を{開|ひら}いた。
examples.english: The company's senior management held an emergency meeting.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{首脳陣|しゅのうじん}のもとで、{会社|かいしゃ}の{方針|ほうしん}は{大|おお}きく{変|か}わった。
examples.english: Under the new leadership, the company's direction changed considerably.

notes:
Formed from {首脳|しゅのう} (a top leader) plus the collective suffix 〜{陣|じん}. Because 〜{陣|じん} makes the word plural and collective, it cannot refer to one executive; for that, use {首脳|しゅのう} or a specific title.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {首脳陣|しゅのうじん}が{交代|こうたい}する: for the leadership to change hands
- {首脳陣|しゅのうじん}の{判断|はんだん}: the leadership's decision
- {首脳陣|しゅのうじん}に{加|くわ}わる: to join the senior ranks
- {球団|きゅうだん}の{首脳陣|しゅのうじん}: a baseball team's front office and coaching staff

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {経営陣|けいえいじん}: the management team — business only, emphasizes running the company
- {幹部|かんぶ}: executives, senior officials — countable and usable of one person
